stem.text: Two dogs pull a sledge along an icy track, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a sledge on an icy track pulled by two dogs on ropes. Printed labels: dog X pulls with a force of 200 N; dog Y pulls with a force of 120 N; 65°; 45°; forward force; sledge; track.

stem.text: Dog X pulls with a force of $200\,\text{N}$ at an angle of $65^{\circ}$ to the front edge of the sledge. Dog Y pulls with a force of $120\,\text{N}$ at an angle of $45^{\circ}$ to the front edge of the sledge.
What is the resultant forward force on the sledge exerted by the two dogs?
